why: Both themes cover members reconstructing what happened on the canvas, and the boundary between reporting the fate of the work and tracing who changed it is easily blurred in post-hoc accounts.

why.T3-073: The bulk of concepts report what happened on the canvas after the fact — pointing out drawings, reporting deletion or failure, saying the raid is too late (C1116671, C1425135, C1347614, C0464385, C0579016).
why.T3-029: Concepts like C1509543, C1003970 and C0112421 voice grief for the lost effort, which T3-073's reporting gate does not itself carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-073's gate covers reporting what happened to the work but does not reach the voiced grief for the failed effort that runs through several concepts.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1509543 ('Rip r/place'), C1003970 (failed-effort lyric), C0112421 ('Too late') grieve the loss, satisfying T3-029's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-029 is the dispensable of the two; dropping it would lose the mourning tone that gives the theme its second half.

why.T3-056: The room designs and builds one joint NZ–Australia work — combined flags, shared ANZAC design, finishing each other's star patterns — which is T3-056's gate (C0448511, C0479900, C0427924, C0485290, C0248915).
why.T3-011: Several concepts send the room's pixels to help or defend the Australian flag and figures with nothing asked, satisfying T3-011's gate.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-056 carries the joint mark, but not the concepts where the room simply helps or protects a neighbour's own separate flag and figures.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0534178 (helping finish the Australian flag), C1043870 (defending both Kiwi and roo), C1332652 (vowing to protect Steve) send pixels to another room's own work, satisfying T3-011.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-011 is the dispensable of the two; dropping it would lose the neighbourly-help framing that the note places beside the joint build.

why.T3-004: Many concepts correct the mark's look — moving the C, realigning the chevron, fixing the laser angle and reflection, correcting 'nose' to beak — which is design work on the mark (C0720208, C0940308, C1059712, C0256175, C0037507).
why.T3-070: Other concepts circulate or correct coordinates, pixel maps and templates for placers to follow (C1093766, C1111961, C0129474, C0973275, C1199477).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-004 settles the mark's look, but not the circulation and correction of coordinates and templates that keeps a shared build usable.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1093766 (posting a pixel map), C1111961 (coordinate typo), C0129474 (fixing the typo) hand directions to placers, satisfying T3-070.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-070 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the template-and-coordinate upkeep that the note calls 'keep a shared account and plan usable'.

why.T3-009: Celebrations of the finished work dominate: 'we did it', pride, ANZAC Pride survived, greatest moment of the nation (C1323240, C0986024, C1362178, C1428910, C0408704).
why.T3-105: A distinct set of concepts saves or shares the work as it stood — timelapses, final images, snapshots (C0036204, C0304386, C1177340, C0842330).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 carries the celebration but not the acts of preserving the work as a record in timelapse and screenshot form.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0036204, C0304386, C1177340, C0842330 save and share the work as it stood, satisfying T3-105.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-105 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the archival half that the note pairs with the celebration.

why.T3-041: Most concepts propose or judge additions to existing work — Waikato Willie above the kiwi, a poppy between words, explosion effects, a penis on the kiwi, Tui billboard — extending the room's work (C1249157, C1183363, C1006122, C1211876, C1458531).
why.T3-033: An earlier cluster proposes the room's mark itself — laser kiwi over a silver fern, calls for Lazer kiwi — proposing what to make (C0898302, C0756685, C0565368, C0542534, C0011194).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-041 carries the extensions and additions, but not the initial proposals for the room's first mark that the note reopens when the laser kiwi was chosen.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0898302 (brainstorm a uniquely kiwi piece), C0756685 (proposing laser kiwi over a fern), C0565368 ('Lazer kiwi!') offer an idea of what to make to the room, satisfying T3-033.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-033 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the initial-mark proposals that the theme includes alongside the additions.

why.T3-021: Watching, cleaning, repairing and maintaining the kiwi, fern and text dominates the item (C0935223, C0676194, C1457706, C0091559, C0607151, C1146519, C1514431).
why.T3-005: A distinct set raises the alarm and calls defenders against named threats — the Danish, the black-pixel encroachment, the void (C0013375, C1289954, C1135970, C1479833, C0193816).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 carries the maintenance, cleaning and repair, but not the raised alarms and calls to fight back against an attack in progress.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1289954 (raising the alarm Lazer Kiwi is being erased), C1135970 ('DEFEND LASER KIWI'), C0193816 (calling defence against the void) name an attack and the room's answer, satisfying T3-005.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the fight-underway register that the note calls 'watching, defending'.

why.T3-024: Most concepts argue that the room's own work should not cover or destroy others' art — route the laser around Elite, spare the Bard face, stop melting other works (C0005743, C0642591, C0954007, C0416741, C0589320).
why.T3-076: A distinct set reins in the room's own expanders — the destructive laser shenanigans (C0418942, C0033508, C1258629, C0148118, C0271346).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-024 carries the argument for restraint toward others' art, but not the specific act of telling the room's own laser expanders to stop.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0033508 ('kibosh to the errant and destructive laser shenanigans'), C1258629 ('stop expanding the lazer'), C1084649 (stop at the flag border) rein in the room's own attackers, satisfying T3-076.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-076 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the internal call-off that the note treats as part of the arguing.

why.T3-023: The moderators stage a whole-sub April Fools change (a fake merger with r/australia and an invented Syndicated Media Content Program enforced by AutoModerator) that members play inside (C0456317, C0787489, C1001260, C0849228, C0747970).
why.T3-095: A distinct cluster works out whether the announcements are jokes — checking the date, telling fooled readers it is April Fools, praising the prank while asking if it is one (C0718710, C0240461, C1016050, C0472160, C1431070).
why.T3-032: Another distinct cluster objects to the jokes as unfunny or in the way — telling the mods to fuck off with the prank, condemning deleting explanations, calling April Fools the worst day (C1492615, C1534249, C0371090, C0344465, C0406813).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-023 carries the staged takeover, but not the work of testing whether the announcements are real or a joke.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0718710 (noticing automod removals as a joke), C0240461 ('That's the joke'), C1016050 ('It's April Fools you dumb cunts'), C0472160 (hinting at April Fools) test the claim, satisfying T3-095.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-095 is the dispensable against T3-023; dropping it would lose the detection layer that the note calls 'detect'.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-023 carries the staged takeover, but not the objection to the jokes as unfunny or in the way.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1492615 (objecting that deleting explanations makes the joke unfunny), C1534249 (telling the mods to fuck off with the prank), C0344465 (calling April Fools the worst day), C0371090 (telling the mods to piss off) object to the April Fools content, satisfying T3-032.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-032 is the dispensable against T3-023; dropping it would lose the objection that the note names as 'condemn the joke'.

why.T3-014: The theme directs the room's coordination into a Discord — asking whether one exists, offering to join, providing the invite link, inviting helpers there (C0615586, C0073995, C0463151, C0813263, C0700169).

why.T3-016: The concepts ask for or give an explanation of the event itself — what r/place is, the one-pixel rule, what happened to the laser kiwi, a rundown of the flag drama (C0304338, C0633991, C0465423, C0450127, C0135390).

why.T3-006: Many concepts call for or narrate attacks to destroy or erase another room's work — destroying the weeb sign, backdooring Germany, cutting through logos, taking out the Danes (C1034076, C0448433, C1155466, C1016703, C1073875).
why.T3-068: A distinct set turns another room's mark into the room's own sign — hijacking the UK flag into a NZ/AU flag, hijacking the Aussie flag, replacing the Kiwi with Andrea (C1097923, C0556878, C1459184).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-006 carries destroying and erasing rivals' work, but not the conversion of rivals' art into the room's own sign.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1097923 (hijack the UK flag into a giant NZ/AU flag), C0556878 ('HIJACK THE AUSSIE FLAG'), C1459184 (replace the Kiwi with Andrea) turn another's mark into the room's own, satisfying T3-068.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-068 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the takeover-by-conversion that the label names 'takeovers'.

why.T3-002: Many concepts rally the room's members or passers-by to come place — sending people to place pixels, calling lads to help the kiwi, calling for recruits (C1372250, C0915184, C0981858, C0956292, C0684961).
why.T3-070: A distinct set circulates coordinates, pixel maps and templates for placers to follow (C0178360, C0771468, C0435101, C1299694, C1378631).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-002 carries the calls for hands, but not the coordinates, templates and pixel maps that tell placers where to put them.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0178360 (coordinates for the laser kiwi), C0771468 (how to use coordinates and the map), C0435101 (giving joiners the template) share directions, satisfying T3-070.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-070 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the template hand-off that the label calls 'building from shared plans'.

why.T3-010: Most concepts settle lines, routes and shared space with neighbours — clear borders with the Green Lattice, bouncing the laser off PrequelMemes, a route round Elite, portals at Kaj (C0255904, C1529962, C0990418, C0292074, C0124520).
why.T3-194: A distinct set of concepts has a member acting as envoy to another room — sending an envoy to the Green Lattice, asking the red group, appreciating the Elite envoy, asking the Danish envoy for an explanation (C1045901, C0508165, C0588936, C1034918).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-010 carries the settled borders and routes, but not the member sent or arriving as the room's envoy to another room.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1045901 (send an envoy to the Green Lattice for a treaty), C0588936 (appreciating the Elite envoy), C1034918 (asking the Danish envoy) have a member acting for the room toward another, satisfying T3-194.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-194 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the envoy errand that the note lists alongside treaties and borders.

why.T3-087: The theme's core is finding out who did what — asking what happened to the Laser Kiwi, naming LEGO, blaming Elite rather than r/nz, suspecting bots (C0708409, C0748716, C0286788, C0253399, C1460944).
why.T3-073: A distinct set simply tells the story of what happened to the work — the Elite deal, the temporary Danish occupation, the Overnight Wars, the failed translucent tile (C0068179, C0600808, C0773976, C1486765).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-087 carries the search for who caused the damage, but not the plain narration of what happened to the work.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0068179 (recounting the Elite deal and restoration), C0600808 (The Danish occupation is temporary), C0773976 ('And so ends the Overnight Wars'), C1486765 (a failed translucent-tile attempt) report what happened to the work, satisfying T3-073.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-073 is the dispensable; dropping it would lose the plain account that gives the tracing its narrative.

why.T3-014: Same bulk as position 9 — the room moves coordination into a Discord, sharing invites and sending helpers there (C0615586, C0073995, C0463151, C0813263, C0700169).
